cloudflare-pages: Generous free tier and fast static hosting; weaker for server apps.
cloudflare-registrar: At-cost domains with no renewal markup; support is slow or absent.
cloudways: Responsive chat and easy servers; small plans feel slow in WordPress.
dreamhost: Reliable hosting many keep for years; managed WordPress can be slow.
dynadot: Simple, fairly priced registrar with no upselling and easy transfers.
fastmail: Easy move from Gmail with human support; the calendar is clunky.
fly-io: Easy, cheap deploys for small apps; past outages and DIY databases.
flywheel: Easy dashboard, backups and staging; fewer features than WP Engine.
hetzner-server-auction: Dedicated servers far cheaper than cloud; prices rise on old ones.
hosting-com: Helpful support and steady uptime; support is now more AI-driven.
inmotion-hosting: Reachable support and room to grow; renewal prices can jump.
ionos-vps: Very cheap and stable for small projects; hard to cancel for some.
kinsta: Excellent, fast support for agencies; few PHP workers, paid add-ons.
linode: Servers run for a decade; a 2025 outage and price rise disappoint.
namesilo: Free privacy and years of no trouble; poor support, dated interface.
netcup: Strong performance for the price; slow support and tough cancelling.
oracle-cloud: Generous free tier, but free instances are scarce or vanish.
porkbun: Low, predictable renewals and easy transfers; support can be slow.
pressable: Rock solid for WordPress and WooCommerce; one hit plugin limits.
racknerd: Budget VPS with long uptime; no built-in backups or firewall.
rocket-net: Fast sites and quick human help; a heavy plugin site struggled.
spaceship: Cheap, simple registrar with quick refunds; a few had domain issues.
vultr: Fast VPS and quick support; suspensions pushed a few to Hetzner.
zoho-mail: Cheap domain email with a free plan; setup can be fiddly.
